translations.web: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
translations.bsb: do not boast over those branches. If you do, remember this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.
translations.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
translations.asv: glory not over the branches: but if thou gloriest, it is not thou that bearest the root, but the root thee.
